verses.text: A song. A psalm by David. My heart is steady, God. I’m going to sing and make music with my whole soul.
Wake up, harp and lyre! I’ll wake up the dawn.
I’ll thank you, LORD, out among the nations. I’ll sing your praises among the peoples.
Your faithful love is bigger than the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches all the way to the skies.
Rise above the heavens, God! Let your glory cover the whole earth.
Save us with your right hand and answer us, so the people you love can be rescued.
God spoke from his sanctuary: “I’ll celebrate in triumph. I’ll divide up Shechem and measure out the valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim is my helmet, and Judah is my scepter.
Moab is my washbasin. I’ll toss my sandal onto Edom and shout in triumph over Philistia.”
Who’ll bring me into the fortified city? Who’ll lead me to Edom?
Haven’t you rejected us, God? You aren’t going out with our armies.
Help us against the enemy, because human help gets us nowhere.
With God we’ll fight bravely. He’s the one who’ll trample our enemies.
